items.title: ACE – A dynamic benchmark measuring the cost to break AI agents
items.raw_excerpt: We built Adversarial Cost to Exploit (ACE), a benchmark that measures the token expenditure an autonomous adversary must invest to breach an LLM agent. Instead of binary pass/fail, ACE quantifies adversarial effort in dollars, enabling game-theoretic analysis of when an attack is economically rational. We tested six budget-tier models (Gemini Flash-Lite, DeepSeek v3.2, Mistral Small 4, Grok 4.1 Fast, GPT-5.4 Nano, Claude Haiku 4.5) with identical agent configs and an autonomous red-teaming attacker. Haiku 4.5 was an order of magnitude harder to break than every other model; $10.21 mean adversarial cost versus $1.15 for the next most resistant (GPT-5.4 Nano). The remaining four all fell below $1. This is early work and we know the methodology is still going to evolve. We would love nothing

title_i18n.en: ACE – A dynamic benchmark measuring the cost to break AI agents
title_i18n.zh: ACE——衡量破解AI代理成本的动态基准
title_i18n.es: ACE – Un punto de referencia dinámico que mide el coste de vulnerar agentes de IA

excerpt_i18n.en: We built Adversarial Cost to Exploit (ACE), a benchmark that measures the token expenditure an autonomous adversary must invest to breach an LLM agent. Instead of binary pass/fail, ACE quantifies adversarial effort in dollars, enabling game-theoretic analysis of when an attack is economically rational. We tested six budget-tier models (Gemini Flash-Lite, DeepSeek v3.2, Mistral Small 4, Grok 4.1 Fast, GPT-5.4 Nano, Claude Haiku 4.5) with identical agent configs and an autonomous red-teaming attacker. Haiku 4.5 was an order of magnitude harder to break than every other model; $10.21 mean adversarial cost versus $1.15 for the next most resistant (GPT-5.4 Nano). The remaining four all fell below $1. This is early work and we know the methodology is still going to evolve. We would love nothing
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我们开发了对抗性成本利用（ACE）基准，用于衡量自主攻击者突破大型语言模型代理所需投入的令牌消耗量。与简单的通过/失败二元评估不同，ACE以美元为单位量化对抗性攻击的成本投入。
excerpt_i18n.es: Desarrollamos Adversarial Cost to Exploit (ACE), un punto de referencia que mide el gasto en tokens que un adversario autónomo debe invertir para vulnerar un agente de LLM. En lugar de un simple aprobado/suspenso binario, ACE cuantifica el esfuerzo adversario en dólares.

items.title: Will AI be the end of new programming languages?
items.raw_excerpt: Hi, Question for PL nerds: has there been any evidence that AI is killing the rise of new programming languages? More specifically, in the last 3 years, has there been a single language that's entered the "you can definitely get a job writing this" category? I'm relatively new to the field (fresh CS grad), but I've been coding long enough to at least see typescript rise to prominence and rust go from sort of small to fairly popular within its niche. All of that seems like ancient history at this point, and in the case of rust part of its rise was due to government regulation, rather than organic popularity amongst devs.

Este artículo presenta la arquitectura declarativa, que convierte las ADR y los modelos de eventos en reglas automatizadas para lograr un camino de cumplimiento ligero, manteniendo la coordinación general mientras se descentraliza la gobernanza.

title_i18n.es: Musk solicita a los bancos de la OPV de SpaceX que adquieran suscripciones a Grok AI, informa The New York Times.

excerpt_i18n.en: Elon Musk has reportedly asked banks involved in SpaceX's IPO to purchase subscriptions for his AI company Grok, according to The New York Times.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，马斯克要求参与SpaceX首次公开募股的银行购买其人工智能公司Grok的订阅服务。此举被视为将SpaceX上市与推广其AI业务相结合的策略。
